purpose: Verify a student can submit a leave application with details and a supporting document and that it is recorded and routed to the HoD.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; the appropriate HoD exists.
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application with leave details and one supporting document.
expected_result: Application is recorded as submitted and owned by the student; it is available to the appropriate HoD; the required submission notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a leave application without any supporting document is still accepted.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; the appropriate HoD exists.
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application with leave details and no supporting document.
expected_result: Application is accepted and recorded as submitted; it is available to the HoD; no error is raised for the missing document.

purpose: Verify a failure to record leave data creates no submitted application and is reported.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; a failure in recording the leave application data is induced.
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application.
expected_result: The failure is reported to the student; no submitted leave application exists for the student and none is available to the HoD.

purpose: Verify HoD can approve a submitted leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; the HoD is authorized for it.
action_or_input: HoD opens the application, reviews it (including any supporting information), and records Approve.
expected_result: Application details and supplied supporting information are displayed to the HoD; decision is recorded; status becomes Approved; the decision notification to the student is triggered.

purpose: Verify HoD rejection results in Rejected rather than Approved status.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; the HoD is authorized for it.
action_or_input: HoD opens the application and records Reject.
expected_result: Decision is recorded; status becomes Rejected (not Approved); the decision notification to the student is triggered.

purpose: Verify a decision that cannot be persisted leaves the prior state intact and is reported.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; the HoD is authorized; a failure in persisting the decision is induced.
action_or_input: HoD records an Approve (or Reject) decision.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the application retains its prior Submitted state and data; no decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify a student can view current status and history of their own leave applications.
preconditions: An authorized Student has several leave applications in different statuses (e.g., Submitted, Approved, Rejected).
action_or_input: Student opens leave tracking, then opens one individual application.
expected_result: The student's leave applications are listed with current status and available history; the individual application shows its recorded details/history; no leave data is changed.

purpose: Verify an empty history is shown when the student has no leave records.
preconditions: An authorized Student has no leave applications.
action_or_input: Student opens leave tracking.
expected_result: An empty history is displayed without error; no leave data is changed.

purpose: Verify a student can submit a bonafide request that is recorded and made available to the Academic Administrator.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; an Academic Administrator authorized for bonafide processing exists.
action_or_input: Student submits a bonafide certificate request.
expected_result: Request is recorded as submitted; it is available to the Academic Administrator; the required submission notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a failure to record a bonafide request creates no submitted request and is reported.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; a failure in recording the request is induced.
action_or_input: Student submits a bonafide certificate request.
expected_result: The failure is reported; no submitted bonafide request exists and none is available to the Academic Administrator.

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can approve a bonafide request and the certificate becomes available.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; the Academic Administrator is authorized for bonafide processing.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator opens the request, verifies it, and records Approve.
expected_result: Request and relevant student information are displayed; status becomes Approved; the certificate is made available for download; the decision notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify rejection yields no downloadable certificate.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; the Academic Administrator is authorized.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator records Reject.
expected_result: Status becomes Rejected; no approved certificate is downloadable for the request; the decision notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a decision that cannot be saved leaves the request in its prior state.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; a failure in saving the decision is induced.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator records a decision.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the request remains in its prior Submitted state; no certificate is made available.

purpose: Verify a student can download their approved bonafide certificate.
preconditions: The Student owns an approved bonafide request whose certificate is available.
action_or_input: Student opens the approved certificate and downloads it.
expected_result: Access to the student's own certificate is verified; the certificate is provided for direct download.

purpose: Verify no certificate is provided when the request is not approved/available.
preconditions: The Student owns a bonafide request that is not approved (Submitted or Rejected), so no certificate is available.
action_or_input: Student attempts to download the certificate.
expected_result: No download is provided and no protected certificate content is disclosed.

purpose: Verify a student can view the current status of their bonafide requests.
preconditions: An authorized Student has bonafide requests in different statuses.
action_or_input: Student opens bonafide request tracking.
expected_result: The student's bonafide requests are listed with the current status of each; no request state is changed.

purpose: Verify an empty list is shown when no bonafide requests exist.
preconditions: An authorized Student has no bonafide requests.
action_or_input: Student opens bonafide request tracking.
expected_result: An empty list is displayed without error; no state is changed.

purpose: Verify initiating no-dues clearance records the request and routes it in parallel to all seven mandatory authorities.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; authorities for Library, Hostel, Mess, the student's respective Department, Lab, Academic Section and Student Section exist.
action_or_input: Student initiates a no-dues clearance request.
expected_result: The clearance request is recorded; verification requests exist for all seven authorities (Library, Hostel, Mess, respective Department, Lab, Academic Section, Student Section), all pending at the same time; the required submission notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a failure to record/route no-dues clearance is reported and no initiation is claimed.
preconditions: An authorized Student exists; a failure in recording or routing the clearance request is induced.
action_or_input: Student initiates a no-dues clearance request.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the system does not claim successful initiation; no successfully initiated clearance case exists.

purpose: Verify each of the seven authorities can record clearance for its own domain without overwriting the other six, and the consolidated case becomes available only after all seven.
preconditions: An initiated no-dues clearance exists with all seven verifications pending; each authority is authorized for its own domain.
action_or_input: Each authority in turn (Library, Hostel, Mess, respective Department, Lab, Academic Section, Student Section) opens the pending request and records Clear for its domain.
expected_result: Only the recording authority's domain status changes each time; the other six statuses are unchanged; the consolidated case is not available to the Academic Administrator until the seventh verification is recorded, and is available after it; the completion/update notification is triggered when applicable.

purpose: Verify recording outstanding dues leaves the domain not clear.
preconditions: An initiated no-dues clearance exists with a pending verification for an authority (e.g., Library).
action_or_input: The authority records that dues/obligations remain outstanding.
expected_result: The authority's domain is not marked clear; the result is stored for that domain only; other authority statuses are unchanged.

purpose: Verify a verification that cannot be saved leaves the prior domain status unchanged.
preconditions: An initiated no-dues clearance exists with a pending verification for an authority; a failure in saving is induced.
action_or_input: The authority attempts to record its clearance result.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the authority's domain status remains as before (pending); no false clearance state is recorded.

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can finalize no-dues when all seven clearances are clear.
preconditions: A consolidated case exists with all seven authority statuses recorded as clear; the Academic Administrator is authorized for finalization.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator opens the consolidated case and confirms finalization.
expected_result: Results of all seven authorities are displayed; the system evaluates all seven as clear; finalized clearance is recorded; the no-dues certificate is made available for download; the completion/certificate-availability notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify finalization is not permitted when any mandatory authority reports outstanding dues.
preconditions: A consolidated case exists in which six authorities are clear and one (e.g., Mess) reports outstanding dues.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize the clearance.
expected_result: Finalization as no-dues is not permitted; the case remains unresolved; no certificate is made available.

purpose: Verify a finalization that cannot be persisted retains previous statuses and releases no certificate.
preconditions: A consolidated case with all seven clear exists; a failure in persisting finalization is induced.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator confirms finalization.
expected_result: The failure is reported; previous statuses are retained; the clearance is not finalized; no certificate is released.

purpose: Verify a student sees per-authority status and overall status of their no-dues case.
preconditions: An authorized Student has a no-dues case with a mix of authority statuses.
action_or_input: Student opens no-dues progress.
expected_result: The status reported by each applicable authority and the overall case status are displayed; no clearance data is changed.

purpose: Verify no active progress is shown when the student has no no-dues case.
preconditions: An authorized Student has no no-dues case.
action_or_input: Student opens no-dues progress.
expected_result: No active progress is displayed, without error; no data is changed.

purpose: Verify a student can download their finalized no-dues certificate.
preconditions: The Student owns a finalized no-dues clearance whose certificate is available.
action_or_input: Student opens the finalized certificate and downloads it.
expected_result: Access is verified; the certificate is provided for download.

purpose: Verify no certificate is provided when clearance is not finalized.
preconditions: The Student has a no-dues case that is not finalized.
action_or_input: Student attempts to download the no-dues certificate.
expected_result: No certificate is provided and no unfinalized/protected certificate is disclosed.

purpose: Verify a PG student can submit an assistantship claim that is routed to both assigned supervisor roles.
preconditions: A PG student exists with an assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: PG student submits an assistantship claim.
expected_result: Claim is recorded as submitted; it is routed to both the assigned Thesis Supervisor and the assigned TA Supervisor for role-specific verification; claim awaits both verifications; the submission notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a claim is not represented as ready for verification when a required supervisor role cannot be resolved.
preconditions: A PG student exists for whom (scenario a) no TA Supervisor, or (scenario b) no Thesis Supervisor, can be resolved.
action_or_input: PG student submits an assistantship claim in each scenario.
expected_result: Dual-supervisor routing is not completed; the claim is not represented as ready for verification or routed to a supervisor in either scenario; no false routed state is recorded.

purpose: Verify two different supervisors verify independently and the claim reaches the Department Administrator only after both.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists whose Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor are different faculty members; both verifications are pending.
action_or_input: The Thesis Supervisor opens the claim and records verification; then the TA Supervisor opens the claim and records verification.
expected_result: Each view displays the claim and the supervisor role exercised; after the first verification the role-specific verification is stored, the claim remains awaiting the other verification and is not available to the Department Administrator; after the second, both verifications are stored independently and the claim becomes available to the Department Administrator; the relevant notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify that one faculty member holding both roles must satisfy both distinct verification obligations.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists whose Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor are the same faculty member; both role-verifications are pending.
action_or_input: The faculty member records verification in one role only, then records verification in the other role.
expected_result: After the first role-verification the other remains pending and the claim is not available to the Department Administrator; after both are recorded the claim becomes available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: Verify that when verification cannot be recorded no verified state is stored.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists with a pending supervisor-role verification; a failure in recording the verification is induced.
action_or_input: The supervisor attempts to record verification for that role.
expected_result: No verified state is recorded for that role; the claim remains not verified and is not available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can review a dually verified claim and forward it to the HoD.
preconditions: A claim with both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor verifications complete is available to the Department Administrator.
action_or_input: Department Administrator opens the claim, reviews it, and forwards it to the HoD.
expected_result: Claim and both supervisor-role verifications are displayed; the forwarding state is recorded; the claim awaits HoD decision; the relevant notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a claim that cannot be forwarded remains at department review.
preconditions: A dually verified claim is at department review; a failure in forwarding is induced.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to forward the claim.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the claim remains at the department-review stage and is not available to the HoD.

purpose: Verify HoD approval of a reviewed claim hands it to the Academic Administrator for stipend processing.
preconditions: A claim that completed both supervisor verifications and Department Administrator review is forwarded to the HoD.
action_or_input: HoD opens the claim and records Approve.
expected_result: Claim and prior verification/review information are displayed; decision is recorded; the claim is HoD Approved; it becomes available to the Academic Administrator for stipend processing; the decision notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify HoD rejection results in no stipend-processing handoff.
preconditions: A reviewed claim is forwarded to the HoD.
action_or_input: HoD records Reject.
expected_result: Claim is Rejected; it is not made available to the Academic Administrator for stipend processing; the decision notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a decision that cannot be persisted retains the prior claim state.
preconditions: A reviewed claim is forwarded to the HoD; a failure in persisting the decision is induced.
action_or_input: HoD records a decision.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the claim retains its prior state (awaiting HoD decision); no decision is recorded and no stipend-processing handoff occurs.

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can process stipend disbursement for a HoD-approved claim.
preconditions: A HoD-approved assistantship claim exists; the Academic Administrator is authorized.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator opens the approved claim and performs the stipend-processing action.
expected_result: Approved claim and approval history are displayed; the processing outcome is recorded; the stipend disbursement is recorded as processed; the relevant notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a processing failure leaves the claim approved but not processed.
preconditions: A HoD-approved claim exists; a failure in completing processing is induced.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator performs the stipend-processing action.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the claim remains approved but is not marked processed.

purpose: Verify a PG student can track their claims and view stage history.
preconditions: A PG student has assistantship claims at different stages.
action_or_input: PG student opens claim tracking and then opens one claim.
expected_result: Each of the student's claims is listed with its current stage/status; the opened claim shows its available stage history; no claim state is changed.

purpose: Verify an empty list is shown when the student has no claims.
preconditions: A PG student has no assistantship claims.
action_or_input: PG student opens claim tracking.
expected_result: An empty list is displayed without error; no state is changed.

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a thesis-supervisor assignment.
preconditions: A Department Administrator authorized to record assignments, a PG student and a faculty member exist.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records a departmental thesis-supervisor assignment mapping the student to the faculty member.
expected_result: Relevant student and eligible faculty data are presented; the student-supervisor mapping is saved and retrievable.

purpose: Verify a failed save retains previous assignment data.
preconditions: A PG student has an existing thesis-supervisor assignment; a failure in saving is induced.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to record a different thesis-supervisor assignment for the student.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the previous assignment data is retained; no incorrect assignment is recorded.

purpose: Verify a TA assignment can be recorded to a course/subject, a faculty member, or both, as specified.
preconditions: A Department Administrator authorized to record TA assignments, PG students, courses/subjects and faculty members exist.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records three TA assignments: (a) PG student to a course/subject only, (b) PG student to a faculty member only, (c) PG student to both a course/subject and a faculty member.
expected_result: Each assignment is saved with exactly the specified association; a course-only assignment does not imply any faculty mapping; where a faculty association exists it is recorded.

purpose: Verify a failed save retains prior TA assignment data.
preconditions: A PG student has an existing TA assignment; a failure in saving is induced.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to record a new or changed TA assignment.
expected_result: The failure is reported; prior data is retained; no incorrect assignment is recorded.

purpose: Verify a PG student can request graduate seminar scheduling.
preconditions: A PG student exists; a Department Administrator exists.
action_or_input: PG student submits a seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: Request is recorded and available to the Department Administrator; it awaits Department Administrator action; the submission notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify a failure to record a seminar request creates no submitted request.
preconditions: A PG student exists; a failure in recording the request is induced.
action_or_input: PG student submits a seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: The failure is reported; no submitted scheduling request exists and none is available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can schedule and log a requested seminar.
preconditions: A pending seminar scheduling request exists; the Department Administrator is authorized to schedule seminars.
action_or_input: Department Administrator opens the pending request and records a scheduled seminar.
expected_result: The seminar scheduling record/history is updated; the seminar is scheduled and logged; the relevant notifications are triggered; no separate approval step is required.

purpose: Verify a schedule that cannot be recorded leaves the request awaiting scheduling.
preconditions: A pending seminar scheduling request exists; a failure in recording the schedule is induced.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to record the scheduled seminar.
expected_result: The failure is reported; the request remains awaiting scheduling; no scheduled state is recorded.

purpose: Verify a PG student and a faculty member can each view the seminar schedule.
preconditions: One or more seminars are scheduled; a PG student user and a faculty user exist.
action_or_input: Each of the PG student and the faculty member opens the seminar schedule.
expected_result: The scheduled seminar information is displayed to each user; no seminar data is changed.

purpose: Verify an empty schedule is shown when no seminars are scheduled.
preconditions: No seminars are scheduled; a PG student user exists.
action_or_input: The user opens the seminar schedule.
expected_result: An empty schedule is displayed without error; no data is changed.

purpose: Verify a notification-triggering event produces an alert and an email to the relevant recipient.
preconditions: A notification-triggering OAP event occurs (e.g., a leave application is submitted) and recipients can be determined.
action_or_input: The triggering event occurs.
expected_result: Relevant recipients are determined; a notification is generated and sent as both a system-generated alert and an email.

purpose: Verify a failed channel delivery is not reported as successful and the business event persists.
preconditions: A notification-triggering event occurs; delivery failure on one channel (e.g., email) is induced.
action_or_input: The triggering event occurs.
expected_result: The failed channel is not reported as successfully delivered; the underlying business event remains recorded.

purpose: Verify a reminder is sent for a pending action meeting the configured reminder condition.
preconditions: An OAP action is pending and the configured reminder condition identifies it as due; the responsible actor is identifiable.
action_or_input: The reminder condition is met and the reminder process runs.
expected_result: The pending action and responsible actor are identified; a reminder is sent as a system-generated alert and email to the responsible actor.

purpose: Verify a failed reminder delivery does not change pending business state.
preconditions: An OAP action is pending and due for reminder; reminder delivery failure is induced.
action_or_input: The reminder process runs.
expected_result: Reminder delivery failure is not reported as success; the pending business state is unchanged and the request is not advanced.
